attributes.content:
**EL-BEAM-1.2 Beam requests from the light stalk**

BCM_Lighting shall set the daylight running and low-beam requests from LightStalk.LightMode, identically for both sides:

| LightMode | DaylightRunningLightRequest | LowBeamLightRequest |
|---|---|---|
| 0 Off | 0 | 0 |
| 1 DaylightRunningLight | 1 | 0 |
| 2 LowBeam | 1 | 1 |

It shall set Left/RightHighBeamLightRequest to LightStalk.HighBeam.

description: Obligation of BCM_Lighting as LightingControl in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-BEAM-1.2).

Realized by ImplementedBCM_Lighting: BeamsStateMachine (state_machines/beams.py) and BEAMS_OUTPUT_FOR_STATE implement the table; on_high_beam() copies LightStalk.HighBeam to both sides. LightMode 2 in Off is ignored, which is correct only under EL-BEAM-1.1.
